negative_control: Replay exactly the selected test workloads with all destinations always up and known to be up (p01=p11=1). If gains persist, they are queue scheduling gains, not recovery prediction or information value.
coupling_contrast: Compare joint_two_step, independent_two_step, myopic_value and urgency_value at K=2 in this control.
recurrence_contrast: Primary registered joint_two_step_absorbing ablation shares p01 but assumes p11=1.
observation_contrast: Primary registered joint_two_step_no_observation discards current response only in its lookahead; the executed controller still receives exactly the same response feedback.
structural_checks: Independent exhaustive two-slot belief tree; deterministic three-job example where a two-slot optimum is worse than the three-slot optimum. Prevent false global-optimality claims.
no_tuning: These controls diagnose the frozen mechanism and do not select a revised controller using test results.
